findings.title: AI uniqueness check misses priority-separated duplicate candidate IDs
findings.impact: Sorting by priority then ID does not make equal IDs adjacent. IDs 1/2/1 with priorities 30/20/10 are accepted in every input permutation; adjacent-duplicate and unique controls behave as expected. Local pre-integration component, not a proven live exploit.
findings.recommendation: Check uniqueness independently of ranking, then retain deterministic priority ordering. Use an explicit ID set or equivalent invariant.
findings.acceptance: All six non-adjacent-duplicate permutations reject; unique candidates preserve canonical rank; limits and valid adjacent controls remain covered.
findings.canonical_owner: AI lane under Game control-plane allocation
findings.deferral_cost: Repeated actors may be considered as separate ranked candidates; invalidates downstream uniqueness assumptions.
findings.superseding_evidence: Verified correction or explicit accepted contract permitting duplicates with separate identities.
findings.deliberately_undecided: AI policy, threat scores, pathfinding implementation and final performance capacities.

findings.title: Direct public effect variants bypass positive magnitude validation
findings.impact: Effect::damage(-7) rejects, but public Damage { magnitude: -7 } passes EffectPlan and commit and changes fixture-health to +7. This characterizes a local model; production gameplay is not activated.
findings.recommendation: Enforce the invariant at a non-bypassable boundary: private validated magnitude/type and/or complete plan validation; preserve atomic rejection.
findings.acceptance: Zero/negative direct Damage and Heal variants reject before effects; positive controls pass; atomic and sequential paths cannot partially mutate on rejection.
findings.canonical_owner: Ability lane under Game control-plane allocation
findings.deferral_cost: Callers may bypass helper validation and reverse the meaning of an effect.
findings.superseding_evidence: Verified invariant enforcement or separately accepted signed-effect algebra; no silent reinterpretation.
findings.deliberately_undecided: Balance formulas, damage magnitude tuning and final ability catalogue.

findings.title: Merged complete early-terminal bridge violates accepted PREPARE phase
findings.impact: PREPARE projection preserves predecessor session/claims; successor changes and mutations of original commit fields happen only inside if commit. Accepted early-terminal semantics require predecessor fencing and successor RECONNECTABLE actor anchor in PREPARE, without controller activation. Final claims validation still expects predecessor. The additive bridge is unactivated; no live corruption or exploit is claimed.
findings.recommendation: Respect the existing #353 repair ownership and owner stop. Restore accepted phase boundaries; keep original FreshAdmissionCommit immutable and make independently loaded prepared successor pass final revalidation. Do not compensate in Server Seam or invent authority in SQL.
findings.acceptance: Before integration, exact successor/claims and predecessor fencing exist at PREPARE with no transport activation; COMMIT alone activates generation/proof/protection; original receipt remains immutable. Independently sourced phase, replay/reload/lost-response/old-predecessor negatives and exact-head canonical qualification must pass.
